editor.ai.scope_on: Looking at the whole project — switch back to one folder
editor.ai.quick_1: Review the scheme: is it ready for a run? Only a list of problems, change nothing.
editor.ai.quick_2: Fix the scheme errors found by the review.
editor.ai.quick_3: Analyze the last run: where it stopped, what failed, where it was slow and what to fix in the scheme.
editor.ai.quick_4: Make the scheme clearer: align it, group the stages, color it by meaning. Do not change the logic.
editor.ai.quick_5: Explain how the scheme works: what goes in, what each step does, how it ends.
editor.ai.quick_6: Check and update the block specs: what to do it with and what to hand in, files from in/, the result to out/.
editor.ai.quick_7: Write specs for the selected blocks.
editor.ai.quick_8: Add a starter if there is none.
editor.ai.quick_9: Lay the scheme out evenly from top to bottom.
editor.ai.quick_10: Give the blocks short, clear names.
editor.ai.quick_11: Prepare the scheme for a new run.
editor.projview.agent_lang_note: Instructions for the leader and worker, run tasks and the built-in AI use this language.
editor.projview.files_server_hint: Cleared — files stay in your scheme folder (in/) and the agent takes them there; needs Chrome or Edge and a connected folder. Set — files go to the server.
editor.projview.files_server_limit: Free on the server: up to {n} files, each up to {kb} KB; a paid account has no such limit.
editor.embed.empty: There are no blocks in this folder.
editor.ai.mic_no_browser: This browser cannot take dictation — open Goblin in Chrome, Edge or Safari
editor.ai.mic_network: the browser could not reach its speech service (no network, or it is closed in your region)
editor.ai.speak_failed: Could not read the answer aloud: {why}
editor.chatpage.empty: The conversation has no messages yet.
editor.ai.mic_denied: The browser blocked the microphone: allow it for this site (the icon left of the address) and in System Settings → Privacy → Microphone
